findings: Positive interior barycentric coordinates in two nested tetrahedra sharing only one vertex were accepted as supported because off-simplex weights fit the physical contact band.
Direct strict-manifest loader accepted non-hash forward identity text.

changes: Supported shared-simplex contact now requires zero off-simplex barycentric coordinates. Band-only contact becomes uncertain_reference_boundary with null motion; wider interior overlap remains ambiguous.
Portable loader checks forward identity SHA syntax before artifact loading. Valid sha256-prefixed identities remain supported.

independent_controls: Analytical nested-overlap control proves both barycentric interiors strictly positive; now receives null instead of supported motion.
Quadratic field in an obliquely rotated and translated frame verifies inverse point mapping and linear-only displacement-vector mapping with m-to-mm conversion.
Three-cell shared-edge traces and reversed element order agree.

Controlled local-trace perturbations place two traces 1.5e-12 m apart although each lies 0.75e-12 m from first; all-pair continuity rejects. Only the basis-return value is monkeypatched in this isolated aggregation corruption control.
All six declared statuses survive full NPZ/JSON portable adapter; every unsupported status preserves null displacement and exact query hash.
Coherently rehashed foreign source bytes are refused before sample_field/point location.
Duplicate ZIP members, truncated numeric data, object arrays and Fortran order reject before numpy.load; allocation callback is instrumented to fail if reached.

scope.artifacts: Constructed analytical tetrahedra and temporary NPZ/JSON only.

limitations: Boundary tolerance remains 1e-12 m. Requiring exact shared-simplex barycentric zeros is deliberately conservative: a rounded oblique boundary may return null uncertainty. No query clamping, snapping or extrapolation.
Global mesh overlap/deformation validity and closed anatomical domain QC remain upstream responsibilities. Pointwise multi-cell ambiguity checks do not establish a valid patient domain.

Complete field bytes, executing source and frame are hash-bound; referenced numerical evidence is not reinterpreted as authentic solver proof. Actual source/model authority and freeze chronology are enforced by the separate comparison/release workflow.
SHA syntax validation alone is not authorization. Cooperative-host reproducibility is the scope.
Limits are 10,000 nodes, 20,000 elements, 4,096 queries/candidates and 64 MiB per encoded/expanded artifact, not measured runtime or an aggregate memory promise.
The all-pair perturbation test isolates the continuity reduction; it is not a physical discontinuity measurement.
Software interpolation coverage does not establish accurate tissue mechanics, clinical usefulness or prediction accuracy.
